name: Essex-Lopresti Injury
definition: Axial forearm injury involving radial head fracture, interosseous membrane disruption and distal radioulnar joint instability.

investigations.principle: Radiographs of elbow, forearm and wrist are required; CT/MRI may define associated injury.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, physeal, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Treating the radial head alone without recognizing longitudinal forearm instability leads to poor outcomes.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Hasta-bhagna/Snayu instability phenotype may be documented after modern diagnosis.

patientEducation.summary: Axial forearm injury involving radial head fracture, interosseous membrane disruption and distal radioulnar joint instability.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, open injury, severe deformity, rapidly progressive neurological symptoms, suspected infection or other listed red flags.
